# STEM Saturdays

- **Goal / definition of done:** run free Saturday STEM enrichment (robotics, coding, science) for
  ~180 middle-school students across the fall/spring terms at the community learning center.
- **Owner:** [Sarah Chen](../people/sarah-chen.md) (rolls up under tutoring/program delivery).
- **Status:** **active — on track.** Funded by a mix of unrestricted dollars and corporate in-kind;
  **not dependent on the [Hearthstone grant](hearthstone-grant.md)**, so unaffected by that decline.

## Open items
- Recruit 2–3 more volunteer STEM instructors for the fall term.
- Explore a corporate STEM sponsor (route non-Cascade prospects; see
  [James Whitfield](../people/james-whitfield.md) recusal).
